title: Prenuvo stacked scan panels
description: Full-bleed night panels, each a little taller than the window with a wide arced top, that pin in place while the next one slides up and arcs over it. Each carries a thin vertical timeline with a glowing coloured dot, a semibold title, a lead, an optional list of features with tinted icons, and an outline and a gradient pill; desktop adds a tall figure slot on the right. The copy rises 80px and fades in as each panel arrives.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); the stack is about 4.2 windows tall for three panels (each 120svh, pinned for another 30svh)
each panel's media fills it like object-fit: cover (photo or video); empty shows a tone gradient (teal, sky, crimson)
pure CSS: position sticky plus view-timeline reveals; with reduced motion the copy is simply there
name: prenuvo-panels
